title: 📦 Bulk Batch QR Generator is Here!
message: Need multiple QR codes for your shop, tables, or events? Create dozens of branded QR codes at once and download them all in a single ZIP file!
points: 📦 Create in Bulk: Add multiple links, Wi-Fi networks, contacts, or UPI amounts and generate them together in seconds.
📁 1-Tap ZIP Export: Export your entire batch of custom QR codes packaged neatly into a single ZIP file to share anywhere.
🖼️ Save All to Gallery: Download all your batch codes directly to your phone's photo gallery with one tap.
🗂️ Clean Batch History: Your batch creations are now neatly organized into single entries in history so you can edit and reuse them anytime.

title: 📷 Instant Live Camera Scanner is Here!
message: We've upgraded your app into a full universal scanner! Now you can scan any QR code instantly in real-time using your camera or gallery.
points: 📷 Live Camera Scanner: Point your camera at any QR code to decode it instantly without taking photos manually.
💡 Flashlight & Flip Camera: Built-in torch toggle for scanning in low light and one-tap camera switching.
⚡ Smart Quick Actions: Open links, send emails, save contacts, and pay via UPI with just one tap.

title: 🌟 Discover the DevDuo Software Hub!
message: We're excited to introduce the DevDuo Software Hub — your new gateway to explore all our top-rated apps, tools, and games in one place!
points: 🚀 DevDuo Software Hub: Easily browse, explore, and download other useful apps and games created by our team.
🎨 Polished Look & Feel: Re-designed cards, sleeker layouts, and smoother animations throughout the app.
⚡ Performance Tweaks: Engine optimizations for quicker screen loading and smoother app performance.

title: ⚡ Faster UI & Massive PRO Price Drop!
message: We've polished the interface, supercharged the app's performance, and made unlocking PRO much more affordable for everyone.
points: 🎨 Sleeker Design: Enjoy a refined, smoother user interface that makes navigating and customizing your QR codes feel effortless.
🚀 Lightning Fast Performance: Under-the-hood engine improvements mean quicker loading times and instant generation.
💎 Cheaper Premium Tiers: We've permanently dropped our PRO prices and added exciting new Flash Deals so you can unlock everything for less!

title: 🩺 Meet the Scannability Doctor!
message: Never save a broken design again. We've built an intelligent, real-time design auditor that verifies your custom QR code colors, contrasts, and logos are 100% readable before you print or share.
points: 🩺 Scannability Doctor Engine: A new dedicated checker that calculates relative color luminance contrast on a single tap[cite: 4].
🚦 Real-Time Safety Ratings: Instantly get clear status updates like 100% Fully Verified Scannable, Warning, or High Scan Failure Risk[cite: 4].
🚀 Optimized UI Badges: Redesigned diagnostic headers with full screen-breathing space to prevent layout compression or horizontal overflows[cite: 4].

title: 🎛️ Layout Fine-Tuning Studio!
message: Ultimate design freedom is here. We've added precise spacing and padding sliders so you can craft perfectly balanced, professional QR code artwork.
points: 🎛️ Fine-Tuning Studio: A new expandable workbench to adjust your layouts in real-time.
📐 Pixel-Perfect Spacing: Complete slider control over Frame Padding, Banner Gaps, and Global Card Margins.
🖼️ Zero Overlaps: Keep your branding banners cleanly separated from your QR data matrix perfectly.
⚙️ Migration Safety: Your custom spacing settings are securely saved to your history history log database seamlessly.

title: 🔒 Password Protected QRs!
message: Take control of your data with our biggest security update yet. Now you can lock your QR codes behind a secure password.
points: 🔐 Secret QRs: Password-protect URLs, Wi-Fi, Contacts, and more!
🖼️ Fresh Branding: Added beautiful new banner styles to make your QRs pop.
⚡ Faster History: We've optimized the history tab so your past creations load instantly.

title: 🔔 The Update Hub is Here!
message: We've added a beautiful new way to keep you perfectly in sync with our latest tools and features.
points: ✨ In-App Notifications: See when new updates are available right from your home screen.
📖 Interactive Version History: Tap the checkmark icon to read past update notes anytime.
🚀 Performance Boost: Faster QR generation and smoother scrolling.
